about: GENERATED by node scripts/check-recommend.mjs --write. The Dex's taste chips (specs/v4.2/spec.md 1.3) per catalogue id, in Dex order. Bits 0-6: the flavour chips, in `flavours` order (the scorer says it at least once); 7-13: the spirit chips, in `spirits` order (its base, or the bottle itself); 14: a cocktail; 15-21: the flavour said plainly (a hit of 1, which decides a drink's For-you section). `stamp` hashes drinks.json, barIndex.json and src/lib/recommendCore.ts. Read by src/lib/dexOrder.ts.
